description: Use this library's permission component when a study records a participant's screen. It requests access to screen capture and any configured webcam or microphone recording, then starts the configured recordings. For webcam-only recording, use the `webcam-recording` library instead.

screenRecordingPermission.description: Get permission to start Screen recording

additionalDescription: The `screenRecordingPermission` component is required before any screen recording begins. It also handles webcam permission for combined screen and webcam studies, and includes a microphone check when audio recording is enabled. Set `uiConfig.requireEntireScreen` to `true` alongside `uiConfig.recordScreen: true` to require a verified entire-monitor share for recorded tasks. In that mode, recorded tasks stay blocked until the browser verifies a monitor capture, and participant page-exit, focus, visibility, and display-count observations appear on the Analyst timeline. Browser support for capture-source and display-count reporting varies. See [Record Screen and Webcam](https://revisit.dev/docs/designing-studies/record-screen/) for setup and participant permission details.
